interactables.name: Read the relay
interactables.title: A vow, left in the relay
interactables.text: The child passed east. We lit every lantern. If you come after us, keep them burning. — Relay keeper, ninth watch

interactables.name: Watch Morrow
interactables.title: Morrow · rain condenser
interactables.text: It counts each drop as if the desert were still listening. A patient machine. An older kind of courage.

interactables.name: Inspect the Wayward Bell
interactables.title: The Wayward Bell
interactables.text: Three mismatched engines. One faithful hull. Her captain leaves a lamp in every port.

interactables.name: Read the oath board
interactables.title: No price for the lost
interactables.text: Bring back the missing. Take no coin from the mourning. Some contracts are older than money.

interactables.name: Listen at the Still Ember
interactables.title: The Still Ember
interactables.text: Pilots speak softly here. The barkeep keeps their names, and never their debts.

interactables.name: Examine the fallen drive
interactables.title: A heart without a hull
interactables.text: The drive outlived its ship. The salvagers have given it a gentler duty: warmth.

interactables.name: Inspect the sand crawler
interactables.title: The patient caravan
interactables.text: It moves one valley a year. Nothing that it carries is ever abandoned.

interactables.name: Attend the watch beacon
interactables.title: The far lantern
interactables.text: A light is a promise made to someone you may never meet.

interactables.name: Read the clan archive
interactables.title: The iron remembers
interactables.text: We inherit no throne. Only tools, names, and the duty to leave a road behind us.

interactables.name: Listen to the barkeep
interactables.title: A cup, before the road
interactables.text: The keeper sets out two cups. One for you. One for the small machine. Hospitality does not ask how a heart is made.

interactables.name: Inspect the repair bench
interactables.title: The patient art of mending
interactables.text: A scout chassis waits beneath the work lamp. Its replacement plates carry three different makers marks. The fourth will be yours.

interactables.name: Read the star ledger
interactables.title: A map of those who returned
interactables.text: Blue marks name the roads still open. Amber marks name their keepers. One unmarked light waits at the edge of the chart.

interiors.name: The Still Ember
interiors.note: Hang your iron by the door. Every weary light has a place here.

landmarks.name: Listen to the barkeep
landmarks.title: A cup, before the road
landmarks.text: The keeper sets out two cups. One for you. One for the small machine. Hospitality does not ask how a heart is made.

interiors.name: Kestrel Repair House
interiors.note: A scar is a record of something that kept working. Set your tools beside mine.

landmarks.name: Inspect the repair bench
landmarks.title: The patient art of mending
landmarks.text: A scout chassis waits beneath the work lamp. Its replacement plates carry three different makers marks. The fourth will be yours.

interiors.name: The Oath Archive
interiors.note: No crowns are kept here. Only names, and the roads they left open.

landmarks.name: Read the star ledger
landmarks.title: A map of those who returned
landmarks.text: Blue marks name the roads still open. Amber marks name their keepers. One unmarked light waits at the edge of the chart.

districts.name: The Ninth Courtyard
districts.note: Rain keeps no banners. Keep your small light close.

districts.name: The Sundered Line
districts.note: A narrow road is still a road. Let no small light fall behind.

districts.name: Emberwatch Ridge
districts.note: Hold until the last warm light. Some promises need only presence.

districts.name: Lantern Exchange
districts.note: Trade your iron. Keep your word. The market remembers both.

districts.name: The Iron Wadi
districts.note: Nothing here is useless. Some things are only waiting for a second oath.

districts.name: Cinder Landing
districts.note: Every ship carries a leaving. Every lantern offers a return.

districts.name: The Far Watch
districts.note: Past the ridge, the old sentries still face the long dark.

districts.name: The Hidden Refuge
districts.note: The small are not the weak. Here, every watch is kept for them.

districts.name: Kestrel Drydock
districts.note: Rebuild the wings. The sky belongs to those who return.

districts.name: Obsidian Bastion
districts.note: Their walls were built to end the road. We brought a door.
